The **Black Powder Pistol** is a non-automatic pistol in *Fallout 76*.

The weapon uses .50 Caliber Balls as ammunition. It has a unique reloading animation that involves the player character using a ramrod to push a single lead ball down the pistol's barrel. The right side detail reads "U.S/H.ASTON" and "MIDDTN/CONN/1850."
